jobs.title: Global Sales Program Manager (SMB Sales)
jobs.location: San Francisco, California, United States; Remote: United States
jobs.description: About the Role We’re looking for a hands-on sales program manager to build and scale new revenue programs across OpenAI’s global SMB sales teams. Your first focus will be outbound: designing acquisition plays, launching pilots and turning what works into repeatable programs. You’ll combine sales judgment, program management and the ability to drive execution through other teams. Working closely with regional vendor managers, frontline leaders, Enablement, RevOps and product and pricing partners, you’ll bring clarity to what we’re launching, how sellers should execute and how we’ll measure success. In this role, you will: Build and roll out sales plays: define the audience, targeting, messaging, outreach, qualification and handoff, then work with vendor teams and Enablement to get sellers ready. Own pilot performance: agree goals and a baseline, review results, diagnose gaps and recommend what to scale, improve or stop. Measure qualified pipeline, conversion and revenue as pilots mature, alongside seller productivity. Drive execution through teams: coordinate regional vendor managers and vendor leaders, establish clear owners and milestones, and resolve blockers without taking over day-to-day team management. Bring cross-functional clarity: work with product, pricing, RevOps and Enablement partners to explain changes, assess their impact on programs and translate them into practical seller guidance. Build with AI for scale: develop repeatable workflows for account research, seller preparation, quality checks and reporting. Validate quality before expanding adoption. Make successful programs repeatable: document simple playbooks, adapt them across regions and use frontline feedback to keep improving. You might thrive in this role if you have: 3-6 years directly managing sales programs or leading a sales team in a fast-paced tech, fintech, startup or comparable environment. Hands-on outbound, SDR or acquisition program experience, with clear examples of what you built, how you measured performance and what improved. Strong program management: the ability to turn an ambiguous goal into a practical plan, align teams and follow through on delivery. Commercial and analytical judgment: the ability to diagnose funnel performance and distinguish activity from meaningful pipeline and revenue outcomes. Confidence working across sales, operations and product partners, bringing clarity to decisions and translating complexity into simple actions. Practical experience using AI to improve workflows and scale execution while maintaining quality. Experience managing vendors or outsourced sales teams is a plus, not a requirement. Relevant backgrounds include sales program management, outbound or acquisition leadership, and hands-on sales team management. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement . Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form . No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link . OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager - Aviation
jobs.description: Work with Us. Change the World. At AECOM, we understand that large programs require the management, coordination and integration of multiple, concurrent projects. By connecting our expertise across services, markets, and geographies, we manage outcome-driven projects that deliver social, economic and environmental value. These include programs of critical national importance in defense, transportation, water, clean energy, environmental clean-up, international development and disaster recovery, as well as the shaping of many of the world’s major cities. There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world. We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us. AECOM is seeking an experienced Sr Program Manager to lead major U.S. airport development and capital improvement programs. This position will be based in Las Vegas, NV. This right candidate provide strategic direction, oversight, and leadership for complex aviation initiatives, ensuring successful delivery across planning, design, and construction. The Senior Program Manager will work closely with airport authorities, multidisciplinary teams, external stakeholders, and AECOM leadership to drive program execution, mitigate risks, and maintain alignment with client objectives. This position offers an opportunity to manage high-visibility airside and landside programs that shape long-term airport infrastructure, enhance passenger experience, and support operational efficiency. Job Responsibilities Program Leadership & Strategy Oversee full program lifecycle for large, multi-year aviation development programs, including planning, design, procurement, and construction. Provide executive-level leadership, decision-making guidance, and strategic direction to technical teams. Establish program governance frameworks, reporting structures, and performance metrics. Drive alignment between client goals, regulatory requirements, operational constraints, and project execution plans. Stakeholder Engagement Serve as the primary interface with airport authorities, senior leadership, regulatory agencies, and third-party partners. Facilitate program workshops, progress meetings, executive presentations, and stakeholder coordination sessions. Build and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with clients and key program participants. Technical Oversight Review program scopes, design deliverables, technical studies, phasing concepts, cost estimates, and construction packages. Provide direction on airside, landside, and terminal elements including runways, taxiways, aprons, roadways, utilities, vertical facilities, and support infrastructure. Monitor adherence to FAA regulations, airport design standards, environmental requirements, and industry best practices. Program Controls & Reporting Manage program budgets, schedules, risk registers, change control, and cost forecasts. Oversee program reporting, dashboard development, and executive summaries. Ensure prompt resolution of issues affecting cost, schedule, quality, safety, and operational continuity. Team Leadership Lead, mentor, and support multidisciplinary teams of project managers, engineers, construction managers, and controls specialists. Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement. Support staff development, recruitment, performance reviews, and succession planning. Minimum Requirements BA/BS and 12+ years of related experience in program or project management for aviation infrastructure projects or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education, including 4 years of leadership. This position requires passing airport-specific background checks and obtaining badges or clearances. Preferred Qualifications Master’s degree in Engineering, Planning, Business Administration, or related discipline. PMP certification or equivalent. Proven experience delivering major airport development programs (airside, landside, or terminal). Strong understanding of FAA standards, airport planning principles, environmental processes, and construction phasing. Demonstrated ability to lead large, cross-functional teams and manage client relationships at the executive level. Experience with program controls systems and reporting platforms. Experience with major hub airports and multi-billion-dollar capital programs. Familiarity with AECOM processes, tools, and integrated delivery models. Strong communication, negotiation, and organizational skills. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. You will join a global organisation recognised for delivering complex and high-impact water and wastewater programs that protect public health, support environmental stewardship, and strengthen communities. This role offers the opportunity to lead transformative infrastructure programs across multiple U.S. markets while contributing to leadership continuity and the development of future program directors. At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment. About AECOM AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options , well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan. AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com. What makes AECOM a great place to work You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager-Corporate Applications
jobs.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are seeking an experienced and execution-oriented Senior Technical Program Manager (TPM), Corporate Applications to join the Information Technology (IT) Delivery Excellence team as a remote employee based in Costa Rica, reporting to the Director, Technical Program Management. In this role, you will be the operational backbone driving strategic technology investments across our corporate application ecosystem, spanning Finance, HR, Legal, and enterprise business systems. You will lead corporate applications portfolio governance, lead quarterly planning cycles, establish portfolio prioritization frameworks, and manage capacity planning processes to translate strategy into execution.

What You'll Do

  • Drive end-to-end portfolio governance across corporate applications, establishing transparency, operational rigor, and alignment with executive business goals and annual operating plans
  • Lead a structured quarterly planning process, including demand qualification, dependency mapping, and resource forecasting across engineering and business systems teams
  • Lead portfolio prioritization, intake frameworks, and capacity planning in close partnership with business application leads, IT functional owners, and leadership
  • Manage complex, high-visibility technical programs across Finance, HR, and Legal platforms from intake and scoping through design, testing, deployment, and adoption
  • Champion PMO best practices and delivery workflows in Jira and Asana, while maintaining structured RAID logs and executive dashboards to ensure flawless delivery

Who You Are

  • You are an action-oriented leader with a relentless bias for action and demonstrated ownership over end-to-end technical outcomes.
  • You thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, skilled at translating high-level business goals into structured roadmaps and decisive action.
  • You are a portfolio management leader who brings clarity to complex technical ecosystems through rigorous governance, prioritization, and capacity planning.
  • You are a collaborative cross-functional partner skilled at building alignment across distributed teams, facilitating executive SteerCos, and driving accountability.
  • You are an exceptional communicator who excels at distilling complex technical dependencies and program risks into clear, actionable executive insights.

What We're Looking For

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience leveraging modern AI tools, intelligent automation, or generative AI technologies to streamline program management workflows, reporting, and operational efficiency
  • 6+ years of Technical Program Management or Senior Project Management experience leading enterprise applications, corporate systems, or IT portfolio implementations within high-growth technology companies
  • Proven track record of cutting through complexity and driving disciplined program execution from intake through production deployment
  • Hands-on expertise facilitating structured IT planning cycles, demand management, resource allocation models, and portfolio governance frameworks
  • Deep practical proficiency with modern program management and collaboration platforms, including Asana, Jira, Confluence, and enterprise PPM software
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or equivalent practical experience

What Will Make You Stand Out

  • Practical experience evaluating, integrating, or operationalizing AI-driven capabilities and automated workflows within enterprise corporate application ecosystems
  • Strong background delivering large-scale programs across core enterprise business application ecosystems such as Salesforce, Workday, NetSuite, SAP, ServiceNow, or Coupa
  • Active PMP, Agile/Scrum (CSM, PMI-ACP), or SAFe certifications, with familiarity in modern IT governance models  and enterprise data and application integrations
